_note: What the store sells. Item ids must match policy/instructions.json, and each product's 'level' must match its 'shelf' there (checked by test_inventory). 'shelf' here is the Nav2 STATION of the rack the product is on (shelf_A ...); 'level' is the shelf level on that rack (upper_shelf, lower_shelf). Prices (INR), barcodes, sizes and initial_stock are PLACEHOLDERS until the real values are known. Live stock is not kept here: see STOCK_FILE in store_agent/inventory.py.
